changes: Fixed font reference frames stabilize ordinary letter sizing and baselines across rows and language punctuation changes.
Ordinary letters use a stable width budget; long custom labels still fit their actual width.
Preserve computed placement until the next layout; hidden hints use the same full-height main region.
Compact fallback is applied to the whole occupied row band, preserving readable primary labels.
Removed redundant main-label centering control and its settings/search strings.
Maintenance policy now requests controls only for meaningful preferences and optional/input-intercepting features.
Declared generated asset descriptor dependencies for regular lint analysis and models, including joint assemble/lint invocations.

validation.initial_joint_release_lint_failure: Existing generated-asset implicit dependency; corrected in AndroidAppConventionPlugin.

limits: No physical-device validation; emulator includes matching display density, several fonts, large text and compact rows.
Graph results are lower bounds; unresolved dispatch, cross-language references and process-discovery limits remain.
Local release signing uses only a temporary verification certificate; production APKs are signed by GitHub Secrets.
